purpose: Replace the resource-walled genus-two Jacobian search on the two current sign-orbit representatives by an explicit degree-two elliptic quotient over K=Q(i), then use elliptic Chabauty to enumerate all quotient points with Q-rational x-coordinate.

prior_resource_walls.result: Both representatives unresolved by external/resource termination; no mathematical credit.

generic_derivation.involution_check: f(-1/x)=-f(x)/x^6, so sigma has order two over K
generic_derivation.rationality_map: For every nonexceptional C(Q) point, X=A*(x-1/x) is Q-rational. Therefore C(Q) maps into the subset of E(K) whose x-coordinate lies in Q.
generic_derivation.reverse_filter: For any finite rational quotient x-coordinate X, put u=X/A. A rational parent x can exist only if u^2+4 is a square in Q, since x^2-u*x-1=0. Each resulting rational x is then exact-tested on C and against U,V,A,B/delta.
generic_derivation.exceptional_parent_points: x=0 and x=infinity are outside the affine quotient formula and have V=0, hence are receiver-degenerate. The other rational Weierstrass x-values x=+-1,-n,1/n have one of the selected factors U,V,A/B equal to zero and are also receiver-degenerate.

magma_adapter.mw_success_semantics: On success, the returned abstract group maps injectively to a subgroup of finite odd index in E(K).
magma_adapter.completion_logic: Elliptic Chabauty returns all points in the known subgroup with Q-rational x-coordinate and an integer R. With IndexBound=2, R has only 2-primary prime divisors; if PseudoMordellWeilGroup success gives odd index, gcd(index,R)=1 and the returned set is complete for E(K).

credit: Diagnostic until exact returned quotient x-values, rational parent reconstruction, four-factor pullback, and separate proof replay are persisted and hostile-audited. No sign-partner transfer is authoritative before audit of the sign adapter.
